name: Marisol ALVAREZ, Appellant, v. NORTHGATE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, Appellee

opinions.author: HOLLOWAY, Circuit Judge
opinions.text: Alvarez appeals the entry of judgment for her landlord. A residential tenant cannot contract away the implied warranty of habitability, and a lease clause purporting to waive it is void as against public policy. The judgment is reversed.

opinions.author: REEVES, Circuit Judge
opinions.text: I respectfully dissent. The majority reaches a question the parties did not brief.
A landlord may not resort to self-help eviction; possession must be recovered through the judicial process. We affirm the award of damages.

text: A default judgment entered without valid service is void, and a void judgment may be attacked at any time. The cause is remanded with instructions to vacate.
